scenes.name: THE DOUGHNUT
lines: Wrap a grid around a doughnut, so every row and column closes into a loop.
把一张网格裹到甜甜圈上：每一行、每一列都首尾相接，绕成一个圈。
On every edge, write one bit: zero means stay, one means flip.
每条边上写一个比特：0 表示不变，1 表示翻转。
Every small square checks out. Yet walk once around, and you come back flipped.
每个小方格都对得上账；可绕着走一整圈，回来时却被翻了过来。

scenes.name: PAINT THE CORNERS
lines: The honest way to make such bits: paint every corner black or white.
最老实的造法：把每个角涂成黑色或白色。
Write one on an edge when its two ends differ. That is a gradient.
一条边两端颜色不同就写 1，相同就写 0。这叫梯度。
Around any square the color changes an even number of times, so the bits add to zero. That is flat.
绕任何一个小方格走一圈，换色次数总是偶数，四个比特加起来是 0。这叫平坦。
So we assume the reverse: flat squares mean someone painted the corners. Why should they?
于是我们想当然地倒过来推：每格都平，就一定有人涂过颜色。凭什么？

scenes.name: ONE SEAM
lines: Take a three by three grid, right side glued to left, top glued to bottom.
取一张 3×3 网格：右边粘到左边，上边粘到下边。
Write one on the three edges crossing the right-hand glue, zero elsewhere.
在跨过右侧粘合线的三条边上写 1，其余全写 0。
Each square on that seam holds two ones. Two flips cancel, so every square is flat.
缝边上的每个方格各含两个 1；翻两次等于没翻，所以每格都平。
Now paint. Start black and walk along a row: stay, stay, flip.
现在来涂色：从黑色出发沿一行走——不变、不变、翻转。
You come home white. No painting works: the row adds up to one.
回到起点却成了白色。怎么涂都不行：这一行的和是 1。
Like a spiral garage ramp: every step looks fine, but one lap lands you a floor higher.
就像停车楼的螺旋坡道：每一步都好好的，绕一圈却高了一层。

scenes.name: TWO LOOPS DECIDE
lines: Lean checks the exact rule: a flat labeling is a painting if and only if two loops add to zero.
Lean 内核检验了精确判据：平坦标号来自涂色，当且仅当两条圈上的比特和都是 0。
One loop runs along the first row, the other down the first column.
一条圈沿着第一行，另一条沿着第一列。
And on every grid at least three by three, the seam is flat, its row adds to one, and no painting makes it.
并且在每张至少 3×3 的网格上，这条缝平坦、行和为 1，任何涂色都造不出它。

scenes.name: ONE IN FOUR
lines: On the three by three grid, eighteen edges give two to the eighteen labelings: over a quarter of a million.
在 3×3 网格上数一数：18 条边，一共 2¹⁸ = 262144 种标号。
Only one thousand twenty-four are flat. Just two hundred fifty-six come from paintings.
其中平坦的只有 1024 种，来自涂色的只有 256 种。
So one flat labeling in four is painted. The rest hide a seam: across, down, or both.
所以平坦标号里恰好四分之一是涂出来的；其余的藏着一条缝：横向、纵向，或两条都有。
Lean checks these ratios for every grid size.
Lean 内核对任意大小的网格检验了这些比例。
And the squares obey exactly one rule: here each edge borders two squares, so all of them add to zero.
方格之间有且只有一条规矩：这里每条边都夹在两个方格之间，所以全部方格加起来是 0。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: In this chapter's lattice language: bits are links, flat is zero action, and a painting is pure gauge.
换成本章的格点语言：比特是链变量，平坦就是零作用量，涂色就是纯规范。
So zero action need not be pure gauge. Every square checks out, yet the loop still flips.
所以零作用量不一定是纯规范。每格都对得上账，绕一圈照样翻。
This is about bits on a two-dimensional grid. Whether four-dimensional Yang–Mills has a mass gap is still open.
这里讲的是二维网格上的比特。四维杨—米尔斯理论有没有质量间隙，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-three.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十三章
